title: Deep Feature Pyramid Convolutional Networks with In-Place Activated Batch Normalization for Automated Skin Lesion Boundary Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:1812.00877v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Segmentation of skin lesion boundaries in dermoscopic imaging is an important prerequisite step for computer-aided diagnosis of malignant melanoma, but remains challenging due to fuzzy margins, occluding artifacts such as hair and blood vessels, low contrast, and high inter-patient variability. This work presents a memory-efficient deep convolutional neural network framework for lesion boundary segmentation, developed for the ISIC 2018 Challenge (Task 1: Lesion Boundary Segmentation). A U-Net-style encoder-decoder architecture is adapted using Wide ResNet38 and Dual Path Network (DPN) backbones with a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) decoder, pretrained on ImageNet. translated_title: 基于原位激活批归一化的深度特征金字塔卷积网络用于皮肤病变边界自动分割
translated_abstract: 在皮肤镜图像中分割皮肤病变边界是恶性黑色素瘤计算机辅助诊断的重要前提步骤，但由于边缘模糊、毛发和血管等遮挡伪影、低对比度以及患者间高变异性，这一任务仍具挑战性。本工作提出了一种内存高效的深度卷积神经网络框架，用于病变边界分割，专为ISIC 2018挑战赛（任务1：病变边界分割）开发。采用U-Net风格的编码器-解码器架构，基于Wide ResNet38和双路径网络（DPN）骨干网络，并配备特征金字塔网络（FPN）解码器，在ImageNet上预训练。原位激活批归一化（InPlace-ABN）减少了训练期间的内存消耗，允许在标准GPU内存限制下进行更高容量的集成，结合五折交叉验证、广泛数据增强、快照集成和测试时增强。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合U-Net架构、Wide ResNet38/DPN骨干和FPN解码器，并利用InPlace-ABN减少内存消耗的深度网络框架，有效解决了皮肤病变边界分割中的模糊边缘和遮挡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep network framework combining U-Net architecture, Wide ResNet38/DPN backbones, and FPN decoder with InPlace-ABN to reduce memory usage, effectively addressing fuzzy margins and occlusions in skin lesion boundary segmentation.
